tribe.name: Tribe 1
history: an egg hatches -- the flock grows (The hatchling glows faintly in the dark, its dreamscape visible as wispy lights in its wake.).
[5136ms] GATHER_ORE: We're short on Stone and need to make some more. Stone is crucial for building, and we need to replenish our supply. | 214 Duneglass is fetched from the mine
an egg hatches -- the flock grows (This young Lark has a faint luminescence to its plumage, shifting from emerald green to a soft, white glow when in deep thought.).

[5254ms] PLANT_CROP: We must grow our population to secure a permanent Capital City and ensure the tribe's long-term survival. Planting a farm plot gives us food and supplies, even if it takes some time to mature. | a new plot is fenced and planted, scarecrow set to keep it clear -- 3 now growing
MirRen is home and gives Chief Akara a full report: nothing new found, though not empty-handed -- bringing back 81 food foraged along the way

an egg hatches -- the flock grows (The hatchling exhibits the ability to briefly change the color and brightness of its plumage to match the patterns of the surrounding environment, creating a shifting luminescence like a moving aurora.).
tribe.last_reflection: Immediate needs are being met, but long-term security needs to be prioritized to ensure the tribe's future.

tribe.chief_philosophy: The tribe's strength is forged by a balance of immediate needs and future growth, utilizing foresight and calculated risk-taking to secure a sustainable future.
tribe.chief_dream: A thriving tribe with a wall that protects against raiders and a bountiful harvest to sustain us for generations to come.
tribe.chief_victory: Akara navigated a perilous journey through the treacherous canyons of the north, displaying cunning and bravery as he rescued a lost child and guided the group through, earning the tribe's respect and ensuring the safety of their journey.
